verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developers page says users can "use our API directly to take full control of your workflow," so a first-party API is claimed. The pack contains no API reference, endpoints, auth model, or examples, and probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, and markdown docs all returned 404. Those 404s show missing machine-readable docs rather than contradicting the API claim, so this is partial rather than disputed. Missing for 10: published API reference documentation, endpoint/operation coverage, authentication details, OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on confirmation the API is publicly accessible.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
